note: Curated 'is X dead' first batch. Selection basis: recurring Steam-forum/is-dead query demand documented in docs/games-subsite-prd-2026-08.md research (2026-08-22). appids are validated at fetch time — a non-ok API response excludes the game from page generation entirely (zero-fabrication rule). caveat = the honesty line the fabricated-count competitors omit.

games.name: Team Fortress 2
games.caveat: Steam is TF2's only platform for the living population, so this number is the whole picture.

games.name: THE FINALS
games.caveat: Also on PS5/Xbox with crossplay — console players are NOT in this number and Embark publishes no console figures. Steam trend is the best public proxy, not the total.

games.name: Dead by Daylight
games.caveat: Large console and Epic populations are not in this number; Behaviour reports 50M+ lifetime players but no live splits. Steam is a lower bound.

games.name: Fallout 76
games.caveat: Xbox/Microsoft Store and PlayStation populations are not visible here. Steam trend only.

games.name: Overwatch 2
games.caveat: Most PC players use Battle.net, which publishes no numbers — the Steam count is a small minority slice and materially undercounts the game. Treat it as a trend signal only.

games.name: HELLDIVERS 2
games.caveat: PS5 population not included; Steam has historically been the larger half but Sony publishes no split.

games.name: Destiny 2
games.caveat: Console populations (historically the majority) are not in this number. Steam trend only.

games.name: Apex Legends
games.caveat: Console players and EA-app PC players are not in this number. Steam is a minority-but-consistent sample.

games.name: Sea of Thieves
games.caveat: Xbox/Game Pass population (historically large) is invisible here. Steam trend only.

games.name: New World: Aeternum
games.caveat: Console version launched Oct 2024; console players are not in this number.

games.name: Battlefield 2042
games.caveat: Console and EA-app populations not included. Steam trend only.

games.name: PAYDAY 3
games.caveat: Console players not included; PC is the historical core of the franchise.

games.name: Rust
games.caveat: Console Rust is a separate product (different codebase); this number is the real PC population.

games.name: No Man's Sky
games.caveat: Console, Game Pass and GOG players not included. Steam trend only.

games.name: Warframe
games.caveat: Console players and standalone-launcher players are not in this number. Steam is the largest visible slice.

games.name: Call of Duty (HQ)
games.caveat: Battle.net and all console populations are invisible — for CoD the Steam number is a small slice of a very large multi-platform population.
